entry_launched.description: The graphical fixed entry started its target: after at most 10 seconds the child still runs (child_state running) or exited 0 (exited, child_exit_code 0). Exit 0 (stable-entry.md).

entry_selection_unavailable.description: A fixed entry read no usable install\active.json: it is missing, cannot be read or breaks install-selection v2; nothing was started. Exit 1 (stable-entry.md).
entry_selection_unavailable.common_causes: An A/B root whose pointer is missing or damaged.
entry_selection_unavailable.handling: Open the recovery UI or run an installer's install status for the root.

entry_selection_inherited_stale.description: A fixed entry inherited an install selection that differs from install\active.json; it refuses for every entry rather than follow an old selection. Exit 1 (stable-entry.md).
entry_selection_inherited_stale.common_causes: A caller that did not clear ACTINGCOMMAND_INSTALL_ROOT and ACTINGCOMMAND_INSTALL_SELECTION.
entry_selection_inherited_stale.handling: Start the entry with both variables cleared.

entry_target_not_in_member.description: The selected member's manifest does not list the entry's program name; nothing was started. Exit 1 (stable-entry.md).
entry_target_not_in_member.common_causes: A member without that program, or a rollback to a version without it.
entry_target_not_in_member.handling: Use a program the selected member carries.

entry_target_modified.description: The target program's size or SHA-256 differs from its member's manifest; nothing was started. Exit 1 (stable-entry.md).
entry_target_modified.common_causes: A slot file changed after it was placed.
entry_target_modified.handling: Prepare the slot again with the installer.

entry_operation_unfinished.description: The actingd entry refused to start the Runtime: an installer operation that row 7a'' stands aside for is unfinished, and the start does not carry its ACTINGCOMMAND_INSTALL_OPERATION. Exit 1 (stable-entry.md).
entry_operation_unfinished.common_causes: An old Startup-folder launcher or a person starting the Runtime in the middle of an update.
entry_operation_unfinished.handling: Run actingctl install resume or install undo for the operation.

entry_layout_unknown.description: The entry does not lie under <root>\runtime\ or <root>\ui\, or the root is no A/B root. Exit 1 (stable-entry.md).
entry_layout_unknown.common_causes: A copy of the entry outside an A/B root.
entry_layout_unknown.handling: Run the entry of an A/B root.

entry_spawn_failed.description: The entry could not start its target; the OS's failure is the caused_by link. Exit 2 (stable-entry.md).
entry_spawn_failed.common_causes: The target cannot be executed, or access is denied.
entry_spawn_failed.handling: Check the slot and the OS's failure; prepare the slot again when it repeats.

entry_child_failed_early.description: The graphical entry's child exited non-zero within 10 seconds. Exit 2 (stable-entry.md).
entry_child_failed_early.common_causes: The program failed at its start.
entry_child_failed_early.handling: Read the program's own log and the entry's fixed log.

entry_report_done.description: --entry-report printed the entry's identity line and started nothing. Exit 0 (stable-entry.md).
